title: Woman Holding Toddler, 1959 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white candid snapshot from June 1959 showing a woman wearing dark-framed cat-eye eyeglasses and a jacket, holding a young toddler outdoors. In the background, lush palm trees and a suburban house with a parked car capture the post-war Sunbelt boom of late 1950s America. The photograph features a classic scalloped border with the date stamp 'JUN 59' printed along the front right margin.
